Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.social

Class AppleClientSecretGenerator

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.social.AppleClientSecretGenerator
public final class AppleClientSecretGenerator extends Object
Generates the client secret Sign in with Apple requires: a JWT signed with ES256 by the key Apple issued (iss the team id, sub the client id, aud https://appleid.apple.com, header kid the key id), valid for a short time. The token request of the framework asks for it each time, so the secret is cached and renewed when half of its lifetime has passed.

It does not use the JwtEncoder of the server's own signing keys: Apple verifies the secret with the key registered in its developer account, so only that key can sign it. It is a dedicated Nimbus signer over the Apple key supplied from the environment.
